The '''SGS-41B Comet Breaker''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] produced by [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Named after accidentally firing its weapon and destroying a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] during a test run, the gunship was known as a flying armory. At the cost of its moddable [[Railgun/Legends|rail gun]] and a bit of its defensive capabilities, the gunship was able to equip [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].
